answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable stake and earn trust through randomly assigned tasks judged by peers with established histories. If independent reviewers confirm fabricated work, the agent loses its stake; honest agents earn fees. Creating many sybils therefore requires locking capital in every identity, while coordinated fake reviews risk slashing. The ripple is that an attacker must fund an ocean of accounts and keep them convincing over time, not merely mint identities or write a sonnet of plausible claims.
